title: Your 2023-24 Smart Classroom Management Report Card nt-report-card/
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin offers readers a personal, fifteen-item self-assessment -- the annual SCM 'report card' -- that scores adherence to core SCM principles like following the plan calmly, avoiding intimidation, building rapport, and minimizing personal stress, then converts the total into a martial-arts-style belt rank from white to red. He frames the tool as a way to convert vague feelings about the past school year into concrete, actionable data correlated with student behavior, motivation, and achievement, and explicitly urges brutal honesty over generous self-scoring. The 'elite' red-belt tier is introduced as new this year, reflecting Linsin's claim that results at the very top level feel qualitatively different -- almost effortless -- compared to the merely strong black-belt tier below it. He closes by encouraging low scorers to use the results diagnostically, targeting specific weak items through the SCM archive or books, and suggests real improvement (a jump from white to black belt) is achievable within a single summer of focused work.
points: A 15-item self-scored checklist covering plan adherence, calm enforcement, rapport, praise discipline, and personal stress converts into a belt rank from white to red.
Honest, unflattering self-scoring is explicitly encouraged over generous self-scoring, since the tool is meant to guide real improvement rather than validate the past year.
A new top-tier 'red belt' rank was added because results at the very highest level of implementation reportedly feel qualitatively different from merely strong performance.
Low scorers are directed to target their specific weak items in the SCM archive or books rather than treating the whole approach as a failure.
quotes: To review, the SCM report card is a rating system that revels the extent to which you followed SCM during the past school year.
I encourage you to fill it out and take the numbers seriously. I believe them to be accurate and correlated with student behavior, motivation, and academic achievement.
So be brutally honest. To the forthright go the victory, and maximum growth.
I created an elite top level (red belt) because even though the level below it (black belt) is excellent there is a substantial jump in results at the very top.
At this pinnacle your abilities will feel almost supernatural. You’ll be able to visualize precisely what you want and have it play out right in front of you.
